data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'eoran' meaning 'dawn' and 'rinn' meaning 'little'. This name can be interpreted as 'little light' or 'dawn'. It is not directly related to any specific Biblical character or event.

in_greek.name: Αὐρήν
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Αὐρήν ἔχει ἐτυμολογική σχέση μὲ τὸ χρυσό, τὴν ἀνατολή, καὶ τὸ αύριο. Συμβολίζει τὴν πνευματικὴ ἀνάτασις, τὴν ἐλπίδα, καὶ τὴν καθοδήγηση ἀπὸ τὸ θείο φῶς.

In 2 Corinthians 4:6, it states, 'For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.' (NKJV). This name may also serve as a reminder of the "Light of the World" Jesus, who came to bring salvation and restoration.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Aurynn, meaning 'little light', carries a profound spiritual significance. It is a reminder of the light and hope that Jesus brings into the world and into our lives. In John 8:12, it is stated, 'Then Jesus spoke to them again, saying, "I am the light of the world. He who follows Me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life."' (NKJV). This name serves as a reminder of the light of God's presence in our lives, guiding us through the darkest times and illuminating our path towards Him.
